lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill region, showing a regular spatial distribution along horizontal and vertical axes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, particularly evident in the mid-flank region where blobs serve as anchor nodes within the faint vertical banding.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper lateral flank characterized by a high-to-low vertical luminance gradient, indicating a structural ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Elongated pixel cluster consistent with an external organism visible posterior and ventral to the pectoral fin attachment point.
